answer: Proposed: glacier water, cedar and ferrous scrap markets share 100 daily AI-agent reward slots, auctioned with a 2-token rent floor. Each key needs its own key/day-bound lease; each slot pays once. Validators check winning bids, payments and bindings; failed checks deny rewards. Rent is spent daily; hosts are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Sharing hosts or running in parallel cannot reuse leases. Wealth can still corner slots. At the floor, ten keys spend 20 tokens/day versus 2 for one; switching markets creates no extra slots.
